assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a game-production WALK cycle sprite sheet for this exact Metrônomo boss from Torii & Hutukara, based on the attached in-game pixel art. Preserve the exact orange-brown rusted layered metal armor, round riveted helmet with narrow amber horizontal visor, big box speaker shield with exactly two dark circular cones stacked vertically, metal gauntlet, brown utility straps and heavy plated boots. Preserve the original chunky detailed 16-bit warm rust and dark-earth palette and thick readable contour. Do not add anything to his body. The source is a reference, replace the pose content with a new 4-column by 4-row grid on actual transparent canvas. Exactly 16 full-body sprites, with four successive walk poses per direction. Row 1 facing south toward viewer, row 2 facing west profile toward left, row 3 facing north away showing his back, row 4 facing east profile toward right. In each row columns 1,2,3,4 are respectively left foot leading and contacting ground, mid-passing step, right foot leading and contacting ground, opposite mid-passing step. The two legs should distinctly alternate, with small armored arm swing and the speaker's weight making the torso subtly counterbalance. Light from upper left, pixels crisp, consistent character height and foot anchor. Each figure is centered within its own equal square cell with generous gutters and no overlap or edges cut. Keep both feet present whenever visible, body fills about 76% of each cell. No text, numbers, separators, floor, scenery, cast effects, drop shadow or glow. Transparent alpha around and between silhouettes. Full 4x4 grid with all rows and columns, clean image suitable for cutting into sprite frames.
assets.method: Built-in image_gen. Atlas crops, scales with nearest neighbor, and registers the sixteen RGBA poses at their foot anchors.
